datasets.name: Gumuskaya et al. 2024, Motile Living Biobots (PMC10811512) article and supporting information

checked.method: GET PMC article page and search the text for a data availability statement and supplementary files

variables_present: article text with reported transition and consistency summaries
Supplemental Videos 1-7 and a 1.5 MB Supporting Information PDF listed as downloads
datasets.scope: Anthrobots (adult human bronchial epithelial cells), one paper
datasets.evidence: HTTP 200, 310,783 bytes. Data Availability Statement reads: "The data that support the findings of this study are available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request." The supplement list names Supplemental Video 1 (2 MB mp4), 2 (11.5 MB avi), 3 ... 7 (10.9 MB avi) and a 1.5 MB PDF. The article text states that each Anthrobot begins as a single cell and that cilia localization is seen within one week (about 20 days from single cell to cilia-coated spheroid).

summary: No public record of single-cell seeding, spheroid formation counts or motility tracking exists beyond the 2024 paper itself: its data statement gives data on reasonable request, and the open material is 7 supplemental videos and a PDF plus an unrelated-variable GEO transcriptome series.
next_step: Ask the corresponding authors for the seeding and culture logs and the motility videos, or run the protocol (single NHBE cells in matrix for 2 weeks, then low-viscosity medium) as a new experiment.
obstacles_confirmed: Data available only on reasonable request (stated in PMC10811512).
Supplemental videos illustrate motility and do not establish that each spheroid began as one cell.
